resources.string: New subscription formats: compatible Clash/Mihomo YAML/JSON and Outline JSON.

Install and manage VPN on a router running FoxHole OpenWrt Client, directly from the app.

Subscription refresh, DNS, backups and FoxHole Sentinel app checks have also been improved.\nClash/Mihomo imports supported server entries from YAML/JSON; client rules and external providers are not imported. Outline supports standard JSON and dynamic ssconf:// keys.\nThe OpenWrt switch enables phone management after setup or pairing. Switching it off leaves the router VPN running.
